# Theme Catalogue
Platform-approved theme presets for ModularMenu:
1. `theme-minimal`: Clean whitespace, Inter typography, monochrome with subtle blue accents.
2. `theme-luxury`: Dark surfaces (#121212), Playfair Display headings, refined gold (#d4af37) accents.
3. `theme-rustic`: Merriweather typography, warm earth tones (#8b4513), natural card borders.
4. `theme-contemporary`: Modern geometric Outfit typography, high structure, cyan accents (#0ea5e9).
5. `theme-vibrant`: Playful energy, bright orange (#ea580c) and amber accents, high contrast.
6. `theme-editorial`: Magazine-inspired layout, Cinzel / Lora serif pairing, elegant margins.
